title: Pocketwire Rewards Points Account Settings: Balance Ceiling, Clawback and Expiry
content:
For each Pocketwire Rewards tier the points account carries a maximum balance, a clawback setting for merchant refunds with its window, a setting on whether a clawback may take the balance below zero, and an inactivity expiry period.

| Tier | Maximum points balance | Points clawed back on merchant refund | Clawback window (calendar days after the purchase date) | Clawback may take the balance below zero | Inactivity expiry (calendar months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Rewards Member | 500000 | Yes | 120 | Yes | 12 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Silver | 1000000 | Yes | 120 | Yes | 12 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Gold | 2000000 | Yes | 120 | Yes | 18 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Platinum | 3000000 | Yes | 120 | Yes | 24 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Diamond | 5000000 | Yes | 90 | No | 36 |
| Pocketwire Rewards Obsidian | 10000000 | Yes | 90 | No | 0 |

## Settings explained

- Maximum points balance: earning that would exceed it is not credited.
- Points clawed back on merchant refund: whether points earned on a purchase are clawed back when the merchant refunds it.
- Clawback window: the calendar days after the purchase date within which a merchant refund claws back points; later refunds leave points in place.
- Clawback may take the balance below zero: when this is No, the clawback is cut to the balance.
- Inactivity expiry: the calendar months without any earning or redemption after which the whole points balance expires. A setting of 0 means points never expire, which is the Obsidian setting.

## Readings

- On Diamond and Obsidian a clawback never takes the balance below zero; on Member through Platinum it may.
- A Gold balance expires after 18 calendar months without earning or redemption; an Obsidian balance never expires for inactivity.
